title: arabis arcuata var. hirsuta
intro: Arabis arcuata var. hirsuta, commonly known as Hairy Rockcress, is a perennial plant species within the Brassicaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections. Its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in reducing inflammation, protecting against cell damage, and preventing the growth of pathogens. The bioactive constituents of Hairy Rockcress include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
